sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Immunofluorescence (unpermeabilized cells): peripheral-edge staining confirmed, demonstrating cell-surface expression of the FLAG-tagged construct. No functional (signalling) assay of the tagged protein reported.
sites.rationale: SIGIRR is a single-pass type-I transmembrane protein; the computed topology places residues 1–118 extracellular with no signal peptide (topology string begins O at position 1), making the N-terminus the sole extracellular terminus. Because no ledger line names a residue, the junction is topology-derived: insert_after_residue = 0 (prepend before M1), with residue_after = M (verified from the numbered sequence). The TM boundary begins at residue 119, giving 118 residues of clearance—well beyond the 3-residue minimum. Multiple independent studies (L1–L6) demonstrate that N-terminal epitope tags (FLAG, HA, Myc) on full-length SIGIRR are tolerated and surface-displayed. PMC9318995 (L1) reports N-terminal FLAG-tagged full-length WT-SIGIRR expressed in HEK/mammalian cells; immunofluorescence under unpermeabilized conditions shows peripheral-edge staining confirming cell-surface display of the tagged protein. The same study (L2) and PMC9527062 (L4, L5, L6) independently construct N-terminal FLAG-, HA-, and Myc-tagged full-length SIGIRR for surface and co-localisation studies. No ledger line names a specific residue; all describe the tag as N-terminal.

sources.claim: Under both unpermeabilized and permeabilized conditions, the Flag-tagged WT-SIGIRR alone was expressed throughout the cells that included a peripheral edge, implying its cell surface expression ( Figure 3 A, Supplemental Figure S1 ).

literature_notes: All six ledger lines describe N-terminal epitope tags (FLAG, HA, Myc) on full-length SIGIRR; none names a specific residue, and none reports an internal-loop insertion. SIGIRR has exactly one extracellular terminus (N-terminus, residues 1–118; no signal peptide), so the topology-derived junction (prepend, insert_after_residue = 0) is the only position the ledger supports. The Δ8-SIGIRR constructs mentioned in L2, L3, L5, and L6 are deletion-mutant variants that are intracellularly retained; they do not represent a distinct tag-insertion site and are not promoted to other_positions because the retention is a property of the mutant protein, not of the tag position. The intracellular C-terminus (residue 410, intracellular domain 141–410) is not supported by any ledger line for a surface tag.
